description:
American Express Credit Cards are status symbol amongst Indian Youth. Last year AMEX India stopped taking card applications but after waiting for 6 months they opened the applications for only AMEX Platinum Charge Card and Platinum Reserve Credit Card. But, now you can upgrade your existing AMEX Credit Card to Amex Platinum Travel Credit Card. 

This American Express Platinum Travel Credit Card is best for those who love spend based milestone benefits.

Upgrade: https://www.americanexpress.com/en-in/account/login?DestPage=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.americanexpress.com%2Fen-in%2Fcredit-cards%2Fapply%2Fupgrade%2Fpersonal%2Fplatinum-travel%2F

(Disclosure: If you apply credit cards or other products from any link on this channel, we may get some benefits to support our channel to provide more useful content)

• Join us on X: https://www.x.com/annadmofficial

• Follow me on Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/krishnatrai/
